taxon.note: Scientific and common names as the spec's authors wrote them, and the genus the scientific name is written in.

growth_form.note: The growth form the spec's authors chose from the plant's habit.

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

variants.note: The environments, conditions and seeds chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

taxon.family.note: WCVP v16's family for the accepted name.

taxon.plant_name_id.note: WCVP v16's plant_name_id for the accepted species the name resolves to (the accepted name).

traits.height_typical_m.note: Flora of China vol. 4, Houttuynia cordata (read on eFloras, 2026-10-16): herbs (5-)30-60 cm high.

traits.leaf_length_m.note: Flora of China vol. 4, Houttuynia cordata (read on eFloras, 2026-10-16): blade (1.5-)4-10 cm.

traits.leaf_width_m.note: Flora of China vol. 4, Houttuynia cordata (read on eFloras, 2026-10-16): blade (1.8-)2.5-6 cm wide.

traits.petiole_length_m.note: Flora of China vol. 4, Houttuynia cordata (read on eFloras, 2026-10-16): petiole (0.7-)1-3.5(-4) cm.

traits.leaf_shape.note: Flora of China vol. 4, Houttuynia cordata (read on eFloras, 2026-10-16): blade broadly ovate or ovate-cordate, base cordate (Simpson p. 207: cordate).

traits.leaf_habit.note: A model estimate (confidence high), as no source read gives it.

traits.perennation.note: Flora of China vol. 4, Houttuynia cordata (read on eFloras, 2026-10-16): rhizomes creeping, thin; the stems creep and root at the base, then stand erect.

traits.rhizome_habit.note: Simpson, Plant Systematics (2019) p. 207, Houttuynia cordata: spreads by its rhizomes into dense carpets.

traits.clonal.note: Simpson, Plant Systematics (2019) p. 207, Houttuynia cordata: spreads by its rhizomes into dense carpets.

traits.inflorescence.note: Flora of China vol. 4, Houttuynia cordata (read on eFloras, 2026-10-16): a short dense spike; Simpson (p. 207) says yellow-green.

traits.inflorescence_length_m.note: Flora of China vol. 4, Houttuynia cordata (read on eFloras, 2026-10-16): inflorescences (0.4-)1.5-2.5(-2.7) cm.

traits.inflorescence_bracts.note: Simpson, Plant Systematics (2019) p. 207, Houttuynia cordata: four white, petal-like bracts below the spike.

traits.bract_form.note: Simpson, Plant Systematics (2019) p. 207, Houttuynia cordata: the involucral bracts white and petal-like.

traits.bract_length_m.note: Flora of China vol. 4, Houttuynia cordata (read on eFloras, 2026-10-16): involucral bracts (5-)10-15 mm, oblong or obovate.

traits.flower_colour.note: Simpson, Plant Systematics (2019) p. 207, Houttuynia cordata: the spike yellow-green. The colour is our reading of the words.

traits.fruit_type.note: Flora of China vol. 4, Houttuynia cordata (read on eFloras, 2026-10-16): capsule 2-3 mm, styles persistent.

traits.fruit_size_m.note: Flora of China vol. 4, Houttuynia cordata (read on eFloras, 2026-10-16): capsule 2-3 mm.

traits.flowering_months.note: Flora of China vol. 4, Houttuynia cordata (read on eFloras, 2026-10-16): flowers April-September.

traits.fruiting_months.note: Flora of China vol. 4, Houttuynia cordata (read on eFloras, 2026-10-16): fruits June-October.

generator.params.note: Hand-set: a creeping rhizome sends up many leafy stems in a loose patch (Flora of China: rhizomes creeping; Simpson: forms dense carpets), each with several leaf nodes, its upper leaves little smaller than its lower (Flora of China: blades 4-10 cm). Not fitted to measurements.

allometry.note: 0.4 m at 2 years in the open, within Flora of China's 30-60 cm. Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.

appearance.note: By eye, after Flora of China and Simpson: stems often purplish red; heart-shaped leaves green above, purplish below, drawn on a simple card widest near its full base, 0.75 as broad as long (Flora of China: blades 4-10 x 2.5-6 cm), as no cordate card is drawn yet. The leaf card's petiole is 0.22 of its length, the flora's petiole against blade and petiole together.
